points.t: A patient with a **new melanoma diagnosis** asking what their report, stage and treatment mean.
**Breslow thickness and ulceration** set T; **nodes (N)** and **spread (M)** set the stage.
Excision biopsy (2 mm margin); **WLE 0.5 / 1 / 2 cm** by stage (NG14 2022); SLNB if Breslow > 0.8 mm with risk features; adjuvant therapy for resected stage III (and IIB / IIC).
**Outdated survival data**: AJCC 8 5-year MSS for stage IIA is **~93–94%**, not 80%.

points: **Breslow**: from the top of the granular layer (or ulcer base) to the deepest cell, **in mm**, never diameter.
**Mitotic rate**: prognostic only (removed from AJCC 8 T1); **Clark level not used**.
Report also: microsatellites, LVI / PNI, regression, TILs, margins, BRAF (stage III–IV).

visuals.caption: Breslow thickness is measured in millimetres from the top of the granular layer down to the deepest melanoma cell; it is the strongest prognostic factor for localised melanoma.
visuals.alt: Melanoma cross-section with a vertical depth gauge

points: **T1** ≤ 1.0 mm (T1a < 0.8 mm no ulceration; T1b < 0.8 with ulceration or 0.8–1.0). **T2** 1–2 mm. **T3** 2–4 mm. **T4** > 4 mm (a / b = ulceration).
~5-yr MSS: **IA ~99%**, **IB ~97%**, **IIA ~94%** (T2b ≈ 93%), **IIB ~87%**; lower for IIC and stage III.
N: nodes, in-transit, satellites. M: M1a skin / soft tissue, M1b lung, M1c visceral, M1d CNS.
**Excision biopsy, 2 mm margin**, full thickness; oriented for WLE / SLNB; avoid shave / punch.
SOX10, Melan-A, HMB-45, PRAME; FISH / NGS for spitzoid.
I–IIA none; **IIB consider** CE-CT; **IIC–IV offer** CE-CT (+ MRI brain for IV).
Breslow = depth, not size. “0.6 mm, no ulceration” = stage IA, excellent prognosis.
**In situ ≥ 0.5 cm**; **stage I 1 cm**; **stage II 2 cm** (1 cm if 2 cm would disfigure); III as II + nodes.
Consider if Breslow > 0.8 mm with risk features / > 1 mm; staging, **not survival**.
Completion dissection no longer routine (MSLT-II): nodal ultrasound surveillance.
**IIB / IIC**: pembrolizumab (TA837). **III**: nivolumab, pembrolizumab, or **dabrafenib + trametinib** (BRAF V600). Resected IV: nivolumab. **IIA: none**.
BRAF test all III–IV. **Ipilimumab + nivolumab** (TA400), PD-1 monotherapy, nivolumab + relatlimab; BRAF / MEK combos; T-VEC; radiotherapy / SRS.

limits.t: **IA**: 2–4 visits in year 1 then discharge. **IB–IIB**: 3-monthly for 3 years, then 6-monthly to 5 years. **IIC–III**: plus imaging surveillance. Teach self-examination.

visuals.caption: Wide local excision is planned around the biopsy scar, with margin size set by stage (0.5, 1 or 2 cm), oriented along the limb’s long axis.
visuals.alt: Biopsy scar with three concentric dashed ellipses

items.t: New lumps in or near the scar, between scar and nodes, or new nodes: **recurrence or in-transit disease**.

pearls.t: “Breslow is **how deep** it went, under the microscope.”
Ulceration upstages: Breslow 1.4 mm ulcerated = T2b.
Older 80% stage-II figures are AJCC 7-era data.

quiz.a: 2 cm (1 cm if 2 cm would cause unacceptable morbidity).
None; pembrolizumab is for IIB / IIC.
